messages:
ada: Noticing an uptick in mTLS handshakes failing from services in us-west -> edge-gw. Failures started around 2025-09-02T04:12Z on a small subset of pods.
liam: any error samples?
kms-watchbot: ALERT: KMS Decrypt anomaly for key=prod-keystore-usw at 2025-09-02T04:10Z. principal=serviceAccount:ci-deployer@infra.example.com; signer_fingerprint unexpected for CSR service=edge-gw-usw. Shadow cert created.
sara: that principal is our CI deployer. did we approve any KMS IAM changes lately?
infra-ci: we had a temporary binding last week for a cross-region smoke test. I flagged it as "temp-smoke" in the commit message.
ada: (typo) ada: who created that binding? need the diff + who approved.
liam: quick query: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2025-09-02T04:00:00Z"' --limit 20 | jq '.[] | {time:.timestamp,principal:.protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, key:.resource.labels.key_id}'` returned three decrypts: two by rotator-usw, one by ci-deployer@infra.example.com.
sara: ci-deployer decrypt is unexpected. check terraform commits and pipeline run id for that time window.
infra-ci: pipeline run 9812 did a one-off apply with message "enable-keystore-smoke" at 2025-08-31T23:40Z. Reviewer was ops-lead@infra. The job was meant for staging but target project var pointed at prod due to a test flag.
ad a: ada: ok revoke the binding and rotate. Mitigation: 1) revoke temp binding 2) rotate affected certs to shadow 3) extend audit retention for key to 90d 4) rotate pipeline tokens 5) provenance sweep for any other unexpected principals. Assign liam + sara.
oncall-zoe: I'll take incident lead if we escalate. Keep legal on standby.
liam: running rotate now: `./tools/rotator rotate --service edge-gw-usw --use-shadow`
kms-watchbot: Rotator action: shadow cert provisioned and canary traffic switched. Shadow->primary promotion scheduled in 45 minutes unless rollback.
sara: I'm pulling KMS audit for last 72h and the IAM history for that key. Also exporting decrypt events to sec-bq for quick queries.
liam: egress flows from the rotator pod show outbound to 52.84.10.99:443 which resolves to chainlink-provider.certs.example-cdn.net with UA acme-client/3.0. That provider is our configured CA.
ad a: ada: so the external provider contact looks normal. The issue is CI had Decrypt permission at the same time. Could be accidental, or token leak.
infra-ci: infra-runner logs for job 9812 show user-agent infra-runner/2.0 and actions that created the IAM binding resource. Approval was via the UI with ops-lead. We're pulling who clicked approve.
liam: if approval was legitimate but target was wrong, that's a process gap. If approval was malicious, it's compromise. For now treat as process gap.
sara: adding temporary deny policy to block serviceAccount:ci-deployer@infra.example.com from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on prod keys. Applying now.
infra-ci: applied deny with command: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:ci-deployer@infra.example.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` and org-policy deny set for non-owner pipelines.
liam: verifying canary after rotate: canary shows no handshake failures and issuer fingerprint matches internal CA (expected=ef12:34). Good sign.
ad a: ada: still need full provenance sweep across all prod keystore keys for any temp binds in the last 30 days. schedule weekly scan.
oncall-zoe: I told legal & trust ops to standby. If we find decrypt events by non-org principals escalate to P1.
sara: found one oddity: a Decrypt event showing principal=serviceAccount:external-automation@partner.example.com at 2025-08-29T18:04Z for a different key. Opening a separate thread for that key.
liam: ok keep this thread for edge-gw-usw scope. For follow-ups: 1) infra -> patch pipeline to fail when targeting prod for keystore IAM changes, require 2 approvals 2) infra -> rotate pipeline tokens and force audit logs for approval clicks 3) security -> provenance sweep + extended retention 4) product/legal -> prepare notification templates.
ad a: ada: adding to vuln-triage board, label as "process-gap" until we see evidence otherwise. If partner principal is confirmed forging requests we'll reclassify.
kms-watchbot: NOTE: shadow certs will be auto-promoted at 2025-09-02T05:00Z unless a rollback command is posted.
infra-ci: infra team will roll out the pipeline gating change in the next deploy window.
liam: forensics checklist posted to ticket: `- collect KMS decrypt logs
- collect IAM bind history
- pipeline approval logs
- egress flows for rotator pods
- rotator audit trail for CSR ids`
ad a: ada: thanks everyone. keep updates here, short messages. If anyone sees ci-deployer appear in decrypt logs again ping immediately. :eyes:
